The '''Tenth Tower Company''' is a unit of the [[Tower Guard]].{{ref/book|13|23}}

It was nearly wiped out during the [[Battle of Tar Valon]].{{ref/book|13|23}} It almost certainly was replenished by the remaining [[Younglings]], who no longer wished to become [[Warder]]s.{{ref/book|13|23}}{{ref/book|13|37}}

== Known Members ==

* [[Celark]] (probable) (former){{ref/book|13|37}}
